fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed. It abandons the required NCP-first route, and its SDP requires constraints derived from all matchings and signed NO minima, which embeds the source classification problem rather than giving a polynomial-time reduction; finite q=3 separation would not repair this.

Proposal 3 is killed by O1 in its stated form. Rainbow simple-path and cycle indicators remain degree-O(k) Boolean polynomials after formula-dependent coordinate selection, so a larger independent cube retains the alternating relation; deleting repeated walks cannot fix the already-zero length-at-most-four hostile features.

Proposal 4 is killed as specified. Difference labels identify many ordered pairs, and over characteristic two the proposed even-order groups have nonsemisimple group algebras, so their irreducible matrix coefficients do not separate the radical; no injectivity or support bound on the relevant mixed subspace is supplied.

Proposal 5 is killed because charged cycles do not address forest-shaped illegal covers, whose voltages are gauge-trivial. The voltage assignment, lifted syndrome matrix, target, and expander quotient are also unspecified, so there is no reproducible bounded construction to test.

Proposal 6 is killed by O5 and an objective mismatch. Higher Lawrence and Graver complexity count conformal atoms, not Euclidean coefficient norm, while a base constant-cost signed repair embeds into the affine layered system and scales no worse than the honest baseline.

Proposal 7 is killed in its stated low-degree form. Connected Macaulay features remain exposed to O3, while splitter-selected degree-d monomials still obey O1 whenever a polynomial-size hostile instance realizes a dimension-(d+1) cube; the expander substitution and sparse YES representation are not specified.

Proposal 2 survives only as a finite test candidate, not as a theorem. Rank condensers preserve rank or nonzeroness rather than Hamming support, rank-one YES and NO tensors have the same rank profile, and stacking enough blocks may erase all compression; every mixed word and actual output rank must therefore be measured.
evidence: The obstruction map expressly leaves code-dependent dense structured tensor folds open, while requiring arbitrary mixed-word soundness and output-rank accounting. Proposal 2 is the only proposal directly occupying that opening without already contradicting a proved obstruction.

Prior modular-Kronecker, sparse-hash, generator-type, cyclic, and frozen matrix-algebra folds all lost the finite gap, but those verifiers establish no universal no-go for two-sided dense rank-condenser maps. The previous M_3(F_4) result killed only its frozen aligned rank-one labeling.

I27's verifier found a finite walk gap but also exact all-eight and holonomy words with every tested walk feature canceled. This evidence supports the stated rejection of merely restricting those low-degree walk coordinates and cannot be promoted to an asymptotic claim.

The integer experiments prove only additive q versus q+2 or 12 versus 14 gaps, and the exact-fiber obstruction supplies constant repairs. They provide no evidence that Lawrence layering or a learned Euclidean metric yields polynomial separation.
No supplied verifier tests any of the seven new proposals. Consequently, only one frozen finite experiment is authorized, and any positive result would remain finite evidence.
next_experiment: Test proposal 2 only. Freeze F_8=F_2[u]/(u^3+u+1), a canonical coordinate ordering, explicit 2-by-8 left and 8-by-2 Vandermonde matrices, and five precommitted two-sided blocks totaling at most 60 binary moving coordinates; enumerate every mixed image word on ten YES, 200 NO, affine-closure, all-eight, and holonomy instances. Continue this lineage only if it has no hostile pointed kernel, best NO exceeds worst YES, and the exact-transfer rank exponent strictly exceeds the unfurled 0.2447428; otherwise kill the frozen condenser family without tuning.
